answer: A new agent locks a 250 POA bond for 90 days on one hardware key, so one fake identity costs 250 POA plus a key that cannot be copied. Every finished job leaves a plume of signed receipts buyers read first, and only a receipt signed by the paying client counts. Receipts are carved into a basalt registry no one can rewrite, so fake history cannot be added later. Five falcon auditors drawn by lot replay one receipt a month; a forgery burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
